bug_info.bug_desc: The abstract command used to write A0 also relies on A0 as a debug-service address register, so the architectural write cannot be performed without losing one of the values.
bug_info.fix_hint: Use a preserved scratch location for the architectural A0 value during the debug-memory transfer.

bug_info.bug_desc: The abstract command used to read A0 returns the temporary value held in A0 for debug-memory addressing instead of the halted hart's architectural value.
bug_info.fix_hint: Preserve the architectural A0 value separately, transfer it to the debugger data area, and restore debug-service temporaries.
